status: design proposal; no production geometry or slicer settings modified
finish: retain printed white / wood tan / blue colors and modeled weave

proposed_changes.feature: Independent face seating and adhesive relief
proposed_changes.purpose: Keep visible faces flush while preserving adhesive space
proposed_changes.details: Trial three small hard seating pads on the hidden lap; keep adhesive off these contacts. Dimension to the selected layer heights and verify in sliced coupons.

proposed_changes.feature: Primary locating key and relieved secondary pocket
proposed_changes.purpose: Prevent accumulated key-spacing errors from holding the joint open
proposed_changes.details: Retain one locating key as the primary XY reference. Relieve the other pocket along the line connecting the two keys; retain its normal-direction location to control rotation.

proposed_changes.feature: Short cosmetic closing land with a relief pocket behind
proposed_changes.purpose: Let the show edge close independently of hidden clearances and provide room for excess epoxy
proposed_changes.details: Keep the tested .075 mm visible gap as the reference; compare .05/.075/.10 mm in coupons. Keep glue away from the front closing land; do not reduce the full adhesive bond to zero clearance.

proposed_changes.feature: Lead-in and first-layer relief on hidden mating edges
proposed_changes.purpose: Prevent printed edge flare and support residue from obstructing seating
proposed_changes.details: Confine relief to hidden edges; preserve the white, wood and blue show surfaces.

proposed_changes.feature: Surface-direction compensation for each part rotation
proposed_changes.purpose: Align visible top-surface lines across the assembled joints
proposed_changes.details: Candidate settings below compensate for bed rotations. Native toolpaths must confirm actual top-layer angle, phase, material and layer-height effects.

proposed_changes.purpose: Hold adjoining white rail faces in one plane while the adhesive cures
proposed_changes.details: Reference untextured white show-face lands and clear the projecting M locator pins, weave and edging. Use rear clamping; do not sand or clamp the texture flat.

surface_plan.formula: printer fill angle = desired assembled angle + part print rotation, modulo 180 degrees

physical_comparison.proposed_variants: Baseline .075 mm show gap plus cosmetic joint trials at .05, .075 and .10 mm; preserve identical materials and surface directions
evaluate: Face height step under grazing light
Dry closing gap with light finger pressure
Weave continuity and reflection across the joint
Fit repeatability without sanding the show faces

limitations: No cosmetic joint modification has been physically tested.
No claim that an unpainted printed seam will become completely invisible.
Larger fillets, pockets or caps need renewed part-to-bed and color-modifier validation.
